conformance.scope: Software/accounting and structural evidence fixtures; no external certification

source.source_license_note: No license file identified in the pinned tree. Fetch directly from upstream for research reanalysis; raw data and upstream code are excluded from the distributable bundle.

uncertainty.method: paired task percentile; separate family-cluster percentile; NumPy linear quantile
uncertainty.coverage: Conditional workload-resampling intervals. Exclude human calibration, unseen trials, contamination and judge uncertainty.

sensitivity.note: Changed workloads are distinct estimands; perturbation ranges are not measured calibration CIs.

certification_failures: No independently calibrated frozen human reference registry
Task version mixtures and missing version labels
Harness mixtures; no controlled vendor comparison
Retrospective inclusion cannot prove complete assigned-episode capture
retrospective.claim: Implementable reference-weight accounting; not an intelligence unit, time-saved estimate, endorsed metric, or replicated source study.

certification_failures: No human-time calibration for these 12 items
CLI events did not expose effective model/version or effort attestation
Retained command commitments/event metadata, not complete replayable tool bodies or trusted completeness attestation
No per-episode invoice or complete infrastructure cost
live.interpretation: Repeated small fixed battery; descriptive success only. Not 72 independent task samples. No generalization CI or causal tool advantage.

mutation.limitation: Hand-selected faults. Not exhaustive mutation coverage or proof of no bugs.

simulations.interpretation: Synthetic fixed-registry truth. Conditional task resampling is not a guaranteed trial-uncertainty interval. Bounds assume independent Bernoulli episodes and exact fixed weights.

cross_provider.selection_rule: One alias per named provider, maximum >=4-repeat coverage; alphabetical ties
cross_provider.claim: Feasible calculation across recorded provider aliases; not measurement invariance, current provider performance or independent replication.

counterexamples.implication: W is not a reliability floor, workload-invariant rank, time-saved estimate or economic value. Stable rankings can coexist with erroneous levels.
